**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/29 (Mon) 21:49
- [FACT] Founders and Coders is a non-profit organization based in Finsbury Park, London.
- [FACT] Founders and Coders offers tuition-free web development training.
- [FACT] The organization was founded in 2014.
- [FACT] The training program is practical and project-based.
- [FACT] The program focuses on collaborative learning and peer-to-peer feedback.
- [FACT] Students develop skills in front-end and back-end development, databases, and web security.
- [FACT] Founders and Coders has a community of mentors, volunteers, and industry partners.
- [FACT] The organization emphasizes social impact and aims to create opportunities for underrepresented individuals in tech.
- [FACT] Founders and Coders has launched the "Tech for Better" program.
- [FACT] The "Tech for Better" program provides web development services to non-profits and social enterprises.
- [FACT] Founders and Coders has also launched the "Sustainable Web Development" program.
- [FACT] The "Sustainable Web Development" program focuses on environmentally sustainable web applications.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Mentors at Founders and Coders are experienced web developers who volunteer their time.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Volunteers help with organizing events, providing administrative support, and marketing and outreach.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Industry partners are leading tech companies and startups that provide career opportunities and help shape the curriculum.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The alumni community of Founders and Coders consists of graduates who continue to be involved as mentors, volunteers, and supporters.
- [RELATIONSHIP] Dan Sofer and Anni Rowland-Campbell are brother and sister.
- [FACT] Anni Rowland-Campbell is a co-founder of Founders and Coders.
- [FACT] Anni Rowland-Campbell has a background in service design and has worked in the tech industry for many years.
- [FACT] Dan Sofer has a background in web development and has been involved with various tech startups.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Dan Sofer and Anni Rowland-Campbell's complementary skill sets and shared vision have been critical to the success of Founders and Coders.
